# Preparing to install a cluster on Azure {#installing-azure-preparing-ipi}

Before you install an OpenShift Container Platform cluster on {{ azure_short }} with installer-provisioned infrastructure, you must configure your account, obtain the installation program and `oc` CLI, and optionally prepare disk encryption sets.
